subject: Slow search function
body: I'm trying to find a specific project, but the search function is taking forever to load the results. I've tried re-entering the search query and even clearing my browser cache, but I still can't seem to find what I'm looking for. Can you help me out?
reply: Hi there, Emily! I apologize for the inconvenience. Our search function can be a bit slow at times, but we've made a fix that should help improve performance. In the meantime, you can try using the filters to narrow down your search results. If you're still having trouble, feel free to reach out and I can guide you through some troubleshooting steps. We also offer a public API that might help you achieve your goal more efficiently. Would you like me to send you more information on that?

subject: Can you add custom fields and richer filters to the board?
body: I've been trying to use the labels feature, but it's not flexible enough for my needs. I need to add custom fields and richer filters to the board. Can you please make this happen?
reply: Hi Rachel, thanks for your suggestion! We're actually working on adding custom fields and richer filters to the board. This feature is currently in the works (expected Q3 2024). In the meantime, you can use our web app's advanced filter options to achieve similar results. If you're still having trouble, we can offer a workaround using our API (contact us for details). Let us know how we can further assist you.

subject: Complete app outage
body: This is a disaster! Our entire company's productivity has come to a standstill because the TaskFlow app is completely down. Every page, every task, every notification - everything is broken. Can you please fix this ASAP?
reply: Oh no, Olivia! I'm so sorry to hear that. Our team is working around the clock to resolve the issue. In the meantime, I'm going to go ahead and issue a refund for your Business plan, as you're entitled to due to the significant impact on your business. We'll also be deploying a hotfix to resolve the issue as soon as possible. Please keep an eye on your inbox for further updates. Again, I apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

subject: Missing columns in CSV export
body: I've tried to export our project data using the CSV option, but the resulting file is missing some of the columns I need. The file is also full of garbled characters. Can you help me resolve this issue?
reply: Hi David, Sorry to hear that you're experiencing this issue. Our developers have checked on this and found that there's a problem with the CSV export process. We've issued a refund for the current month as a gesture of goodwill. In the meantime, we've attached a workaround document that explains how to manually extract the missing data. Please try these steps and let us know if you have any further issues.

subject: Can I enable dark mode in TaskFlow?
body: I'd love to enable dark mode in TaskFlow to improve my productivity. Can you please let me know if this is something that can be done and if so, how?
reply: I understand the importance of dark mode in improving productivity. Unfortunately, dark mode is not currently an available feature in TaskFlow. However, we do have a workaround for you. You can enable dark mode in your browser settings. To do this, please follow these steps: 1. Open your browser settings. 2. Click on 'Appearance' or 'Themes'. 3. Select 'Dark mode' from the available options. If you have any further questions or need help with this, please contact our support team at support@emilywilson@example.com. TaskFlow Support

subject: Invoice and VAT details missing
body: Can I get an invoice with VAT details? I need to show this to my accountant.
reply: Hi John, We apologize for the inconvenience. You can find your invoice with VAT details on your account dashboard, under the 'Invoices' tab. You can also request a PDF version of your invoice by clicking the 'Download' button. We hope this helps.

subject: 2FA issues with TaskFlow
body: I'm having trouble with two-factor codes - whenever I try to set them up, I get an error message saying that the code is invalid. I've tried restarting my phone and checking the code, but it still won't work. I'm really confused about what's going on.
reply: Hi Emily, sorry to hear that you're having trouble with 2FA. Can you try removing the 2FA device from your TaskFlow account and then setting it up again? If that doesn't work, please let me know and I'll look into it further. In the meantime, you can also try contacting our support team through our help center (support.example.com) for additional assistance.

subject: File upload issues with task 1234
body: I've been trying to upload a file to task 1234 for hours and it's just not working. Every time I try, I get an error message saying 'Upload failed - please try again later'. I've tried different files and browsers, but nothing seems to work. This is really frustrating and I'm worried I'm going to miss a deadline.
reply: Hi David Lee, sorry to hear that you're experiencing issues with file uploads. Our team is currently investigating the issue, but it looks like we have a fix deployed. Please try uploading the file again now and let us know if it works. If it still fails, please reply and we'll look into it further. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

subject: How do I view a Gantt chart in TaskFlow?
body: I'm interested in using the Gantt view in TaskFlow but I'm not sure how to access it. Can you provide some instructions on how to do this?
reply: I'd be happy to help! To view a Gantt chart in TaskFlow, please follow these steps: 1. Click on the 'Projects' tab and select the project you want to view the Gantt chart for. 2. Click on the 'View' dropdown menu and select 'Gantt'. 3. You can then customize the Gantt chart to fit your needs. If you have any further questions or need help with this, please don't hesitate to ask. TaskFlow Support

subject: SSO setup with Okta failing
body: I've been trying to set up SSO with Okta, but the sign-in process keeps looping or failing. I've checked the Okta side and everything seems fine, but I just can't get it to work. I've tried clicking 'Connect' and 'Verify Configuration' multiple times, but it just keeps going in circles.
reply: Hi Sarah, thanks for reaching out. I've checked our logs and it looks like the issue might be related to the Okta settings. Can you try resetting your Okta app to production and then retrying the connection? If that doesn't work, please let me know and I'll escalate this to our technical team. They'll be happy to assist you further.

subject: Slow loading dashboard
body: I'm having trouble with the dashboard loading, it takes way too long. I've tried refreshing the page, closing and reopening my browser, and even clearing my cache, but nothing seems to work.
reply: Sorry to hear that, Rachel! I've checked on this issue and it looks like we had a temporary issue with our server that's now resolved. Please try updating your browser to the latest version and see if that helps. If you're still experiencing issues, I can offer you a refund for the current billing period. Let me know when you're ready to proceed with a refund.

subject: Need full account data export for GDPR compliance
body: I'm trying to export all user data from our TaskFlow account to comply with GDPR, but I only see the option to export individual projects. How can I get the full account data export?
reply: Sorry to hear that you're having trouble. Our full account data export is available in the CSV export feature. To access it, go to Settings > Data Export > Export all users and projects. This will download a CSV file containing all user and project data. Please note that this feature is available on our Business plan and above. If you're on our Free plan, you may want to consider upgrading to take advantage of this feature. If you still encounter issues, please let us know and we'll be happy to assist further.

subject: Task due dates and reminders incorrect
body: I'm having trouble with task due dates and reminders in TaskFlow. The dates and times are showing up incorrectly and the reminders aren't triggering.
reply: It looks like the date and time zone settings might be off for your account. To correct this, please try updating your account settings to match your company's time zone. If you're still having issues, please let us know and we'll send you a temporary fix until we can deploy a software update.

subject: No email or in-app notifications sent
body: I've been using TaskFlow for my team for a few weeks now, but suddenly I haven't received any email or in-app notifications. I've tried restarting my browser and checking the notification settings, but nothing works.
reply: Sorry to hear that our notifications aren't working for you. This issue is usually caused by an incorrect email address or authentication settings. To resolve, please try updating your email address and authentication settings in your TaskFlow account settings. If you're still having issues, please contact our support team and we'll be happy to assist you further.

subject: Changes not syncing quickly between web and mobile
body: I've noticed that changes I make on our web workspace take around 2-3 minutes to sync to our mobile app. This is causing delays in our team's workflow. Is there a workaround for this or is there a reason it's taking this long to sync?
reply: Hi Emily, I've checked on this for you. It appears that there's a temporary issue with our sync process. We've identified the problem and deployed a fix that should resolve the issue. Please try syncing again over the next hour to ensure the fix takes hold. If you continue to experience issues, feel free to reach out and we'll investigate further.

subject: Card declined when upgrading or renewing a plan
body: I'm having trouble upgrading my plan when it's due for renewal. Every time I try to go through with the upgrade, my card is declined and I get an error message saying 'Invalid card number'. I've tried checking my card details multiple times and everything seems fine.
reply: Hi Emily, sorry to hear that you're experiencing issues with card declines. Could you please try using a different card to see if that resolves the issue? If you're still having trouble, please check your card's expiration date and billing address to ensure they match your payment info. If the problem persists, we can process a refund for you. Please let us know if there's anything else we can help with.

subject: Mobile app crashes on iPhone
body: I'm having a major issue with our mobile app - it keeps crashing and freezing every time I try to open it. I've tried updating the app and restarting my phone, but nothing works.
reply: Sorry to hear that our mobile app is crashing on your iPhone. This is a major issue that requires immediate attention. Our team is working on a fix, which should be deployed by the end of the day. In the meantime, you can try resetting the app by deleting the cache and data, and then reinstalling the app. If the issue persists, please contact our support team and we'll send you a refund for your subscription.

subject: Plan limits unclear
body: I'm having trouble understanding the limits of our plan and I'm worried I'm going to go over budget. I've checked the pricing page and I'm still confused. Can you help me?
reply: Hi Emily Chen, thanks for reaching out! Our plan limits can be a bit confusing at first, but we have a detailed guide on our website that should help clarify things. You can find it under the 'Help' menu in our app. If you're still unsure, feel free to reply and we can walk you through it together. We're here to help!

subject: Importing projects from Trello/Asana fails
body: I'm trying to import a project from Trello/Asana, but it's not working. The error message says 'Invalid project format'. Can you help me fix this?
reply: Sorry to hear that you're having trouble importing projects from Trello/Asana. This issue is usually due to a mismatch in project format. Our import feature only supports CSV files from Trello and Asana. You can try exporting your project from Trello/Asana and importing it from TaskFlow to see if that resolves the issue. Alternatively, you can try contacting our support team (support@emilychen.com) and we'll be happy to assist you in exporting and importing your project manually. Please note that this will require some technical assistance and may take a few hours to complete.

subject: Export job never finishes
body: I started an export job a few days ago, but it's never finished. I've checked the status multiple times and it's still stuck on 50%. Can you help me resolve this issue?
reply: Hi Rachel, Sorry to hear that your export job is stuck. Our team has checked on this and found that the export job was interrupted due to a server timeout. We've manually restarted the job and it should now complete successfully. Please try checking the status again in 15 minutes. If you experience any further issues, please don't hesitate to reach out.

subject: Kanban board drag and drop issue
body: The drag and drop functionality on my Kanban board is broken. I'm having trouble moving cards around and it's really slowing me down. Can you please fix this ASAP?
reply: Hi Rachel Patel, sorry to hear that the drag and drop functionality is broken. We've deployed a fix and it should be available now. Please log out and log back in, then try the drag and drop functionality again. If it still doesn't work, please reply and we'll look into it further. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

subject: Forgot password email not received
body: I signed up for TaskFlow using my work email and now I'm having trouble resetting my password. I sent a password reset request, but the email I received says the link is invalid. I've checked my spam folder, but it's not there. Can you help me figure out what's going on?
reply: Hi David, sorry to hear that. It sounds like there might be an issue with the password reset email. I've checked our systems and it looks like the problem might be related to the email provider. Can you try using a different email address to reset your password? If that doesn't work, please let me know and I'll issue a refund for your subscription fee.

subject: Request for refund or cancellation
body: I want to cancel my subscription and get a refund for the last month. This is taking too long and I need to use my money elsewhere.
reply: Hi Sarah, We understand that you're looking to cancel your subscription and get a refund. We'll be happy to process a refund for the last month. Please allow 3-5 business days for the refund to be processed. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out. We'll also send you a confirmation email once the refund is processed.

subject: Comments and task edits disappearing after saving
body: I've been experiencing issues with comments and task edits disappearing after saving in the TaskFlow workspace. This is majorly impacting my work and I'm unable to save changes. Can you help me resolve this?
reply: I'm sorry to hear that you're experiencing this issue. After further investigation, we found that the problem is caused by an outdated browser version. I've arranged for a browser update to be issued for you. Please try updating your browser to the latest version (currently at 3.1.2) and try saving changes again. If the issue persists, please contact our support team at support@emilywilson@example.com. You will receive a full refund for your Pro plan within the next 24 hours. TaskFlow Support

subject: session expires too fast, keep getting logged out
body: I've been using TaskFlow for my team and I'm getting really frustrated with the constant logouts. We've tried updating our browsers, clearing cookies, and even restarting the app, but the issue persists. Every 20 minutes or so, our team members are automatically logged out and we have to re-enter their credentials.
reply: Thank you for reaching out to us, Emily Wilson. I've checked the logs and it looks like the issue might be related to our recent update on session timeout. It seems that the timeout was set to 30 minutes by default, but we've added a feature to allow admins to adjust the timeout duration. Can you please check your workspace settings and adjust the session timeout to 45 minutes? If you're still experiencing issues, please let me know and we'll investigate further.

subject: How do I connect TaskFlow to my Slack workspace?
body: I've been trying to set up the integration for hours, but I'm having trouble finding the instructions. Can you please help me with the process?
reply: Hi Emily, thanks for reaching out! Unfortunately, we don't have official Slack integration at the moment. However, you can use our web app to connect your Slack workspace using our SSO feature (business plans only). If you're still having trouble, please try the following steps: 1) Go to Settings > Integrations > Slack, 2) Click 'Connect' and follow the prompts. If that doesn't work, we can issue a refund for your business plan and you can try our free plan. Just let us know, and we'll be happy to help!

subject: API errors when pulling data
body: I'm experiencing API errors when trying to pull data from TaskFlow. The error message says 'Too many requests' and I'm not sure how to resolve this. Can you help?
reply: Sorry to hear that you're running into API errors. The 'Too many requests' error is usually due to exceeding the daily API rate limit. We have a free API rate limit of 100 requests per hour. To resolve this, you can try increasing your API key limit by contacting our support team (support@emilychen.com). Alternatively, you can try using our API documentation to implement a retry mechanism or caching to reduce the number of requests. If you're still experiencing issues, please let us know and we'll be happy to assist further.

subject: Duplicate charge and unexpected amount
body: I was charged twice for my workspace last week and I'm extremely upset about it. We've been using TaskFlow's business plan and everything was working fine until I saw the duplicate charge on my credit card statement. I'm really frustrated and need this issue resolved ASAP.
reply: I apologize for the mistake, Rachel Brown. I've checked our system and it looks like the issue was due to an error in our payment processing system. We've issued a refund to your credit card and it should be processed immediately. As a gesture of goodwill, we'd like to offer you a 30-day free trial on our premium plan. Please let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with.

subject: Invite not working for invited teammate
body: I invited a teammate to our workspace but they're unable to accept the invite or join the workspace. We've checked our team settings and it looks like the invite is being sent, but for some reason, it's not being accepted. We're using TaskFlow's web app.
reply: Hi there, I apologize for the inconvenience. It looks like the issue might be due to an incorrect team role assignment. Can you please check the role assigned to your teammate and ensure it's correct? You can do this by going to the workspace settings, then the team members section, and selecting the role dropdown. If you're still having issues, please let me know and we'll double-check the team settings for you.
